mapper.select: SELECT policy_value FROM system_policies WHERE policy_key = 'G2B_BID_NOTICE_RETENTION_MONTHS' AND use_yn = TRUE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM g2b_bid_notice_candidates WHERE imported_bid_seq IS NULL and first_seen_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{retentionMonths} * INTERVAL '1 month')
DELETE FROM g2b_bid_notice_sync_items WHERE (bef_bid_bbanc_no is null or bef_bid_bbanc_no = '') and first_seen_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{retentionMonths} * INTERVAL '1 month')
